name: rejected-resume-hardening
brief: Harden Orcastrate's fallback when the Claude Code CLI rejects a resume. T1 narrows classifyStartupFailure (src/main/pod/errors.ts) so RESUME_FAILED requires CLI wording that names the session: the bare `resume` alternative goes, and the unbounded `session .*not found` is bounded, while the four rejection strings found in the bundled CLI 2.1.235 binary still match; its docblock stops calling the match broad. T2 makes #startFreshAfterRejectedResume (src/main/pod-manager/pod-manager.ts) clear the stored ccSessionId before the fresh retry, so a reopen or Reconnect before the new session id arrives cannot re-send the rejected id or write a second notice, and a failed retry cannot leave it on a beached Pod. Each fix carries regression tests shown red against the unfixed code. T3 removes three .sir/backlog.md lines closed at 77f8fd4 (27, 41, 46), keeps line 47, and gates on the full suite and repo-wide typecheck.
